args: cd '${workspaceFolder}' && export BMI30_BEEP_REALTIME=1 BMI30_DETECT_IN_READER=1 BMI30_BEEP_HOLD_ENABLE=0 BMI30_BEEP_HOLD_DELAY=0.0 BMI30_DETECT_LOSS_SEC=0.0 BMI30_DETECT_COOLDOWN=0.05 BMI30_BEEP_SWEEP=0 BMI30_BEEP_INFO_TONE=0.10 BMI30_BEEP_INFO_GAP=0.0 BMI30_BEEP_CHANNEL_GAP=0.0 BMI30_BEEP_REPEAT_GAP=0.05 && if [[ -x .usbvenv/bin/python ]]; then exec ./.usbvenv/bin/python host/BMI30.200.py.2026-05-24-work; elif [[ -x .venv/bin/python ]]; then exec ./.venv/bin/python host/BMI30.200.py.2026-05-24-work; else echo 'Не найден Python в .usbvenv/bin/python или .venv/bin/python'; exit 1; fi
